descriptions.interaction: Snap! triple/filter/sort blocks; separate translation and execution; result-table popup, variables reused for refinement, JSON/CSV results and TXT query export.
descriptions.guidance: Entity/property label search; syntax-shaped blocks and translation/result feedback. Non-empty result validity not established.
descriptions.visualisation: Tabular results; block syntax is not automatically a node-link graph.

report_level_evaluation.design: Remote Snap!Con2023 single-system qualitative workshop, one-hour protocol including15minute familiarisation; spontaneous chat/email feedback.
report_level_evaluation.tasks: Snap! experts unfamiliar with SPARQL construct and execute simple queries after a tutorial.
report_level_evaluation.measures: Qualitative informal feedback; no controlled task timing, accuracy estimate or quantitative questionnaire.
report_level_evaluation.results: Authors report all workshop participants formulated simple functional queries; evidence lacks objective task logs and experimental comparator.; limits: Self-selected uncompensated14adults. The24high-school learners are cited from a separate earlier report, not an additional current sample; do not pool to38. Discussion mentions1–2hours whereas protocol says1hour. Comparative feature table is descriptive, not a controlled comparator.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Not reported: comparator. Self-selected uncompensated14adults. The24high-school learners are cited from a separate earlier report, not an additional current sample; do not pool to38. Discussion mentions1–2hours whereas protocol says1hour. Comparative feature table is descriptive, not a controlled comparator.
